protocol.base_recipe: Exact v1 architecture/mean pooling, 80-epoch legacy gain/masks/noise training
protocol.inner: For outer fold f, train v1 baseline on the other three folds excluding next-fold validation. Fine-tune each candidate on those three only. Equal clean/anti-aliased-phone inner utility selects candidate.
protocol.outer: Initialize matching frozen v1 four-fold model, retaining its clean train-only normalization; fine-tune selected recipe on four folds, then score untouched outer fold
protocol.final: Average inner utility selects recipe; initialize immutable v1 final trained on390, fine-tune20 on the same390
protocol.anchor: KL with frozen starting teacher on clean TRAINING inputs only, temperature2; teacher never trained on validation/test folds
protocol.augmentation: Clean/anti-aliased8k view50/50 for phone candidates; +/-6dB gain and normalized Gaussian noise .01; no additional masks
protocol.external_role: Previously seen development-validation, not untouched final test
protocol.seed: Inner baseline1000+fold; inner adaptation3000+fold; outer adaptation5000+fold; final5242; no seed search

selection.config_selection_basis: Clean+synthetic-phone inner only, v1 warm start with clean anchor
